title: Elastic and failure response of imperfect three-dimensional metallic lattices: the role of geometric defects induced by Selective Laser Melting

extraction_issues.quote: fabricated with geometric imperfections via Selective Laser Sintering
extraction_issues.reason: 标题及全文使用Selective Laser Melting (SLM)，摘要此处误写为Selective Laser Sintering，且文中明确为SLM工艺，疑为笔误。

extraction_issues.quote: The homogenized value obtained from the reconstructed RVE is in good agreement (5.8%) with its experimental counterpart
extraction_issues.reason: 此处仅给出单一5.8%误差，但页28文字给出octet和rhombicuboctahedron两个值（5.1%和5.8%），且页34全尺寸模拟误差数值不同，疑似原文针对不同模型或表述省略，需核对原文是否连贯。

self_check: 已核对关键数值：相对密度10.4%/14.7%，实验模量690/1250 MPa，强度4.7/9.1 MPa，构建方向模量保留比70%/71%，缺陷统计参数μ_r^h=+24.5%、μ_o^h=17.2%，参数研究中250%放大后模量降至50%、强度降至40%，失效模式转变阈值（octet比值1.8、rhombic比值1.2）等均与提取文本一致。公式方面无复杂公式，统计符号按原文保留。仍不确定：页23的5.8%与页28的5.1%和5.8%之间的对应关系未完全厘清；摘要中'Selective Laser Sintering'疑为笔误但未修改。
